summary: Iteration 17 — Room availability calendar-grid. Backend: 12/13 pytest cases pass (day-schedule shape, RBAC for all 4 roles + 401 no-auth, cancelled/rejected bookings excluded, pending included, sorted by starts_at, midnight-spanning bookings appear on both days, deactivated room hidden from grid but historic bookings still retrievable via /rooms/{id}/bookings). 1 backend minor bug found: date validation accepts any string with 2 dashes (e.g., '2026-13-40', 'abcd-ef-gh', 'not-a-date') returning 200 instead of 400 — request spec requires 400. Frontend: all 9 scripted flows pass — sidebar Rooms link in both AdminLayout & EmployeeLayout, RoomAvailability renders 2 rows + 48 half-hour slots, deep-link ?date=2026-08-01 survives reload, Prev/Next/Today wire URL, weekend badge shows on Sat and hides on Mon, now-line only when viewing today, indigo blocks for approved/auto_approved bookings, block cursor-default + tooltip 'title · time · booker', clicking empty slot navigates to /admin/meetings?new=1&... (or /employee/meetings for employees) and pre-fills dialog with room + start/end + shows green 'Conference Room A is available for this slot' hint, legend labels present.

minor.issue: date validation is too lax — accepts any string with 2 dashes. e.g. date=not-a-date, date=2026-13-40, date=abcd-ef-gh all return 200 with empty bookings instead of the required 400 'date must be YYYY-MM-DD'. Root cause: rooms.py line 178-183 uses `date.split('-')` unpack (only counts parts) rather than validating with datetime.strptime(date, '%Y-%m-%d'). Fix: replace the try/except with `datetime.strptime(date, '%Y-%m-%d')`.

action_items: Backend: strengthen date validation in GET /api/rooms/day-schedule using `datetime.strptime(date, '%Y-%m-%d')` so semantically invalid dates like '2026-13-40' return 400 as documented.
(Nit, still open from iter 16) Add DialogDescription to NewMeetingDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rooms.py day-schedule uses correct overlap query (starts_at < end AND ends_at > start) so midnight-spanning meetings show on both days — verified.

routes/rooms.py — day-schedule builds UTC-only [00:00, 23:59:59.999999] window per date. This is documented but could mis-attribute bookings for users in non-UTC timezones (a meeting starting at 23:30 local Aug 1 may fall on Aug 2 UTC). Not a bug per current spec, but worth calling out — the UI localises via toLocaleTimeString so blocks render at correct local slot within the visible 08:00-20:00 axis.

RoomAvailability.jsx — good use of key={prefill.room_id-starts_at} on NewMeetingDialog to reset form state per deep-link. Room select value is a controlled string that resolves correctly once /rooms fetch completes (verified in test — sub-second delay).

RoomAvailability.jsx bookingToBlock computes width based on clamped startMin (Math.max(0, startMin)) — for bookings starting before 08:00 the left is 0 and width still shrinks correctly. For bookings ending after 20:00 the width Math.min clamps to canvas — verified by 'Workshop 14:00-17:00' rendering correctly.
date param setParams uses functional updater and `replace: true` — good, does not push into history stack for every keystroke.
Only 259 lines — well below the 700-line splitting threshold. Clean separation between grid rendering and prefill navigation.
cursor-default + non-clickable booking blocks (`className` contains cursor-default and no onClick) — prevents accidental rebooking. Good.

rca of the issue: Backend: day-schedule date validation only splits string on '-' and unpacks 3 parts. `'not-a-date'.split('-')` returns ['not','a','date'] — passes unpack, doesn't raise. Fix: `datetime.strptime(date, '%Y-%m-%d')` in the try block. Also handles invalid month/day combos like 2026-13-40 or 2026-02-30. This is the only real defect found.
